subject: Co-branded runtime licensing & go-live milestones
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@glowtech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: private-label runtime for GlowTech Insights

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — GlowTech is excited about the potential to embed a lightweight, low-latency runtime into our Insights product. Our PM org sketched an initial ask and I attached the request PDF (GlowTech_OEM_Request.pdf). Key asks:

- A white-labeled runtime we can ship with our on-prem appliance (minimal UI touchpoints).
- Licensing model that supports per-seat and per-instance tiers.
- Support SLAs during pilot (business hours + one-week escalation).
- Guidance on quantization/packaging for limited GPU footprints.

High-level timeline: pilot in June, GA in Q4 if everything aligns. Could you point me to a term sheet and an estimated cost range so we can budget for exec approval? Also, curious if Redwood offers a co-branded installer or if we should plan for self-embedding (we have a small infra team).

Appreciate any guidance.

Best,
Ellie Park
Head of Partnerships, GlowTech
ellie@glowtech.ai

--- Attachment: GlowTech_OEM_Request.pdf (application/pdf, 138 KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@glowtech.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: private-label runtime for GlowTech Insights

Hi Ellie — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the brief. Looping in Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (commercial ops + MPA) so we can scope licensing and support. Quick answers up front:

- We do offer a private-label runtime (we call it Redwood Private OEM) that supports co-branding and ship-with options. There are two paths: a) fully managed co-branded installer we maintain, or b) an embedding bundle we hand over to your infra team.
- Licensing: pilot pricing is typically a blended monthly commitment + per-instance runtime fee. GA would move to a tiered ARR/usage model.
- SLAs: we can support a pilot SLA with a 4-hour P1 response window and a 24-hour P2 during the pilot period.
- Packaging: Marissa has notes on quantization/playbooks for constrained GPUs.

Can we hop on a 30-min call this week to align on pilot KPIs and whether you want the managed or self-embed path? I left a few slots on Thu 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Developer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@glowtech.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: private-label runtime for GlowTech Insights

Hi Ellie — good to meet you (virtually). Adding commercial detail so you can orient finance and legal quickly:

Attached is a first-pass term sheet (Redwood_OEM_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf) and a short MPA draft (Redwood_MPA_draft.docx). Highlights:

- Pilot structure: 3-month pilot, fixed monthly fee $18k (covering up to 25 instances) + $600 per-additional-instance/month. Pilot includes business-hours support and one named escalation engineer.
- GA licensing: Choose between per-instance subscription or an ARR band (we typically ask for a 12-month minimum ramp).
- Co-branding: allowed in UI chrome and installer, but no modifications to the runtime binary without a code escrow arrangement.
- IP: Redwood retains runtime IP; GlowTech gets a license for distribution per the MPA.
- Compliance: we can ship SOC-2 evidence and an audit-ready checklist.

If this looks broadly OK, Marissa will coordinate a redline process with your legal and procurement. Two asks from our side to speed things up:
1) Confirm whether GlowTech prefers managed-install or self-embed.
2) Share a short list of pilot customers or internal test tenants that will help us size support.

If you'd like, we can package a co-branded installer and a one-day enablement workshop as an add-on.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

--- Attachments: Redwood_OEM_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 92 KB), Redwood_MPA_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 58 KB)
From: Ellie Park <ellie@glowtech.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: private-label runtime for GlowTech Insights

Hi Vanessa / Marcus / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the term sheet. Quick responses:

- We prefer the self-embed path (GlowTech infra will ingest the bundle).
- Pilot sizing: planning for 12 internal test tenants to start, then 3 pilot customers (we'll share names by EOD).
- Legal: I'll run the MPA with procurement; please expect a redline from our procurement lead, Samir Kaur (samir.kaur@glowtech.ai).

Two follow-ups: could you add a short appendix to the MPA about quantization/packaging constraints (target memory per instance and recommended GPU SKUs)? Also, can you confirm whether the pilot fixed fee is refundable (we typically treat pilots as credit toward GA consumption if we convert).

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call. Thu 10:30 PT works for me.

Best,
Ellie
